[SWS_CRYPT_40969]
⌈
The interface ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::CreateKeyAgreementPrivateCtx shall return an instance of ara:-
:crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx implementing the algorithm speci-
fied by the provided parameter CryptoAlgId. The interface shall return
• kUnknownIdentifier, if the provided CryptoAlgId is not supported.
• kInvalidArgument, if the provided CryptoAlgId is supported but does not refer
to key agreement.
⌋
